proposal.notes: Requires admin scope on activity-api to write the template; canary keys hold only read,write. Operator must register via Bearer JWT admin auth or seed via init-data.

template.name: Vessel Health Corroboration
template.description: Cross-reference discovery-vessel registrations against impulse_resolution_metrics over a 24h window to flag fresh registrations whose per-shape failure rate exceeds 80%. Emits a corroboration impulse listing (vessel_id, shape, failure_rate_pct, recommendation) so the binding layer can gate stale registrations from discovery results without removing them outright.

tasks.description: Query discovery-vessel for all currently-registered vessels and their advertised shapes (TTL not expired).
Compute per-vessel x per-shape failure rate over the last 24h from impulse_resolution_metrics.

config.command: curl -fsS -X POST "${ACTIVITY_API_ENDPOINT:-https://activity.metabob.com}/v2/impulses/resolve" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H "Authorization: ApiKey ${METABOB_API_KEY}" -d '{"impulse":{"type":"surrealQuery","pointer":{"query":"SELECT vessel_id, requested_shape, count() AS attempts, count(success = false) AS failures, (count(success = false) * 100.0 / count()) AS failure_rate_pct FROM impulse_resolution_metrics WHERE timestamp > time::now() - 24h GROUP BY vessel_id, requested_shape"}}}' > /tmp/fp15_failure_rates.json

tasks.description: Join the fresh-registration snapshot against the 24h failure-rate aggregate and tag each (vessel,shape) pair with a recommendation.

config.command: node -e 'const reg=require("/tmp/fp15_registry.json");const fr=require("/tmp/fp15_failure_rates.json");const rows=(fr.result||fr.rows||fr);const advert=[];for(const v of (reg.vessels||reg.result||[])){for(const s of (v.shapes||v.advertised_shapes||[])){advert.push({vessel_id:v.vessel_id||v.id,shape:s});}}const idx=new Map();for(const r of rows){idx.set(r.vessel_id+"|"+r.requested_shape,r);}const out=[];for(const a of advert){const k=a.vessel_id+"|"+a.shape;const r=idx.get(k);if(!r){out.push({vessel_id:a.vessel_id,shape:a.shape,failure_rate_pct:null,recommendation:"FORCE_LIVENESS_PROBE"});continue;}const pct=Number(r.failure_rate_pct||0);if(pct>=95)out.push({vessel_id:a.vessel_id,shape:a.shape,failure_rate_pct:pct,recommendation:"REMOVE_REGISTRATION"});else if(pct>=80)out.push({vessel_id:a.vessel_id,shape:a.shape,failure_rate_pct:pct,recommendation:"GATE_FROM_DISCOVERY"});else if(r.attempts<5)out.push({vessel_id:a.vessel_id,shape:a.shape,failure_rate_pct:pct,recommendation:"FORCE_LIVENESS_PROBE"});}require("fs").writeFileSync("/tmp/fp15_corroboration.json",JSON.stringify({shape:"vesselHealthCorroboration",generated_at:new Date().toISOString(),window_hours:24,threshold_pct:80,entries:out},null,2));console.log("entries="+out.length);'

tasks.description: Persist the corroboration result as a vesselHealthCorroboration impulse for downstream binding-layer consumption.
